pages.title: Built for Qatar's heat
pages.panel: Every room we build is sized for a 50°C ambient design condition, because a system specified for a European summer will not hold temperature in July here.
body: The New Doha Kitchen Equipment Services designs, supplies, installs and maintains commercial refrigeration across Qatar — from single chiller rooms for restaurants and bakeries to multi-chamber cold storage for main contractors and industrial sites.
We work from the load upward. Room dimensions, product type, throughput and door traffic determine the heat load; the heat load determines the plant. Nothing is sized from a catalogue page alone.

Panels, doors, refrigeration equipment and controls are sourced from established manufacturers and assembled by our own installation teams. One company carries the job from drawing to commissioning, which means one number to call when something needs attention.
Every installation is handed over with a commissioning record and a warranty period, and can be carried forward into an annual maintenance contract.

pages.title: Cold Rooms
pages.subtitle: Modular panel construction, built on site, sized to the space you have.

pages.title: Walk-in chiller and freezer rooms
pages.lead: Prefabricated PUF sandwich panels with cam-lock joints, assembled on site in any plan dimension. Chiller and freezer chambers can share a wall to save floor area and plant cost.
bullets: Cam-lock joints seal without on-site foaming, so a room can be dismantled and relocated
Panels arrive finished — no painting, no site fabrication, faster handover
Floor, wall and ceiling insulation matched to the design temperature
Chambers can be extended later without replacing the existing structure
pages.footnote: Panel thickness is selected from the computed heat load, not from room size alone.

pages.title: Room types
pages.intro: Four standard configurations. Anything outside these is built to the same construction, sized to your drawing.

items.name: Chiller room
items.line: Fresh produce, dairy, prepared food. Holding temperature +2 °C to +8 °C.

items.name: Freezer room
items.line: Frozen storage with heated door frame and insulated floor build-up.

items.name: Combination chamber
items.line: Chiller and freezer sharing a partition wall — less floor area, one plant location.

items.name: Blast freezer
items.line: Rapid pull-down for freshly cooked or freshly caught product before transfer to storage.

pages.title: Refrigeration
pages.subtitle: Condensing units, evaporators and controls, selected against the computed load.

pages.title: Indicative capacities
pages.intro: A starting point for discussion only. Final selection follows a heat-load calculation using your dimensions, product, throughput and door traffic.
pages.note: Capacities assume 50 °C ambient design and standard door traffic. Blast freezing, high throughput or heavy door usage moves these figures.
